newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina 97 growth forecast conservative - minister.
newsitem.headline: Argentina 97 growth forecast conservative - minister.

text.p: Argentina's official estimate of five percent economic growth for 1997 is conservative and below private forecasts, Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Wednesday.
"Keeping up the (government's economic policies) assures us of growth in the order of five percent in 1997, although you know that is a conservative forecast," Fernandez told businessmen at a lunch.
"In 1996, gross domestic product will grow by a bit above three percent, which clearly means that Argentina has resumed the path from which it was pushed off in 1995," he said.
Fernandez said strongest growth will come in investment and trade, while consumer demand will recover more slowly.
